intro.text: A mountain range in Alethkar, named for the Sunmaker, a king who brought the Alethi highprinces together.

description.text: The range runs across central Alethkar, beside the Kholin, Ruthar, Thanadal and Hatham princedoms.
The Koron accent comes from an area near the mountains in central Alethkar.
In Shadesmar the range is reflected as a body of water, the Salavashi Trench.
